Dhamaal 4 Box Office Performance and Audience Reception

The film 'Dhamaal 4', starring Ajay Devgn, has achieved significant box office success, crossing ₹50 crore worldwide within its first two days. While some reports indicate a strong Saturday jump and surpassing other films in daily collection, audience reactions on social media have been mixed, with some calling the comedy 'terrible' and 'cringe'. The film's performance is being compared to other releases, with some outlets noting it outperformed expectations despite varied reviews.
